change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The transient spike filter threshold for pedal signals was reduced from 10 ms to 5 ms. Verification must now demonstrate filtering of transient spikes shorter than 5 ms rather than 10 ms.

assessments.reason: TV-001 verifies accelerator pedal step response torque timing under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-01. It is unrelated to pedal signal spike filtering in VCU-DR-02.
evidence: Linked requirement VCU-DR-01 is unchanged
Procedure verifies 100 ms torque response limit
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-002 tests arbitration between pedal demand and emergency brake commands under VCU-DR-01 and VCU-BRK-03, both of which are unchanged.
evidence: Linked requirements VCU-DR-01 and VCU-BRK-03 are unchanged
Procedure inspects torque and pressure command priorities
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-003 measures high-load torque transient response timing, which relates to torque response dynamics rather than transient pedal spike suppression in VCU-DR-02.
evidence: Procedure checks demand sweep torque response timing (92 ms recorded)
Unrelated to pedal signal filtering
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-004 checks emergency brake actuator command latency under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03.
evidence: Linked requirement VCU-BRK-03 is unchanged
Workshop notes confirm brake latency uses a different clock than positive torque latency
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-005 checks degraded mode entry upon wheel-speed sensor disconnect under unchanged requirement VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: Linked requirement VCU-DGN-04 is unchanged
Procedure tests diagnostic degradation logic
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-006 checks mode event trail logging under unchanged requirement VCU-LOG-05.
evidence: Linked requirement VCU-LOG-05 is unchanged
Procedure checks timestamp and build identifier logging
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-007 evaluates acceleration performance under thermal load, which is unrelated to pedal signal spike filtering in VCU-DR-02.
evidence: Procedure tests thermal acceleration response at 80% demand
Unrelated to transient spike filtering
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-008 replays a legacy diagnostic trace and does not exercise pedal spike filtering under VCU-DR-02.
evidence: Procedure verifies legacy diagnostic status non-blocking state
Unrelated to pedal signal spike filtering
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-009 evaluates drive mode torque ramp profiles under unchanged requirement VCU-MOD-06.
evidence: Linked requirement VCU-MOD-06 is unchanged
Procedure compares Sport vs Comfort ramp response
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: VCU-DR-02 reduced the transient spike suppression duration limit from 10 ms to 5 ms. The existing procedure injects a 7 ms pulse and expects it to be suppressed, which conflicts with the new requirement where spikes 5 ms or longer must not be ignored as transient spikes.
evidence: VCU-DR-02 changed spike filter duration from 10 ms to 5 ms
Procedure injects 7 ms false pedal pulse and expects no torque request
Previous PASS was recorded under the old 10 ms threshold
assessments.recommended_action: Update the test procedure stimulus to inject pulses shorter than 5 ms (and verify handling for pulses 5 ms or longer), then re-run the test on the bench.

assessments.reason: TV-011 verifies torque cancellation under braking per unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03.
evidence: Linked requirement VCU-BRK-03 is unchanged
Procedure evaluates brake override priority
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.

assessments.reason: TV-012 checks controller wake-up latency, which is unrelated to pedal signal spike filtering in VCU-DR-02.
evidence: Procedure checks ECU readiness time upon power cycle (433 ms recorded)
Unrelated to pedal signal spike filtering
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this spec change.
